description: Gets a calendar by its address, the slug at the end of its link: its links, its teams and seasons, and its games between two instants, the next twelve months when none are given. Use it when someone shares a TeamCalendar link.
name: get_calendar_view

contests.description: Its many-sided contests in the window, such as a Grand Prix's race and sessions, which Games can't name, having no home or visitor. A series' races are counted from these.

league.description: Its league's code, such as F1.

logoUrl.description: The series' own mark, as a list shows the contest; null for none.

meeting.description: Its meeting's name, such as Monaco Grand Prix, in the request's culture.

race.description: Whether it is its meeting's race, the contest a series' calendar counts.

stage.description: Which session it is: race, qualifying, practice-1.

drivers.description: The drivers it follows, by slug (lewis-hamilton), whose lines and places its series' contests carry.

delayReason.description: Why the game was moved, if it was.

abbreviation.description: Three letters, for where even the short name will not fit.

shortName.description: The name for a narrow cell, such as "Guardians".

slug.description: The club's address within its league, from the stored name, as Slug.

key.description: The game's permalink key (2026-10-24-1840-vs-houston-astros), where the read states it; null elsewhere.

score.description: A Final's score as {home}-{away}; null for a live, unplayed or unfinished game.

startTime.description: The start time in UTC; the server never localises it.

abbreviation.description: Three letters, for where even the short name will not fit.

shortName.description: The name for a narrow cell, such as "Guardians".

slug.description: The club's address within its league, from the stored name, as Slug.

leagues.description: The racing series it follows whole: every contest, whatever teams it also picks.

code.description: The league's code, such as F1.

logoUrl.description: Our own mark for the series; null for none.

subscribe.description: The whole addresses a person subscribes with, one for each calendar app, and what an assistant tells them.

appleUrl.description: The one-click link for Apple Calendar, on a Mac, iPhone or iPad: the feed's webcal address.

directions.description: What each link is for and why clicking one is safe, for an assistant to pass on to the person.

feedUrl.description: The feed's whole https address, for any other calendar app's "subscribe by URL".

googleUrl.description: The one-click link for Google Calendar. It opens Google Calendar with the feed ready to add, and the person confirms there. The only way into Google Calendar: Google offers an app no way to subscribe someone to a feed.

manageUrl.description: The page where the person changes the calendar's teams and settings later.

outlookUrl.description: The one-click link for Outlook on the web.

ownership.description: Who owns it, as the caller sees it: none (anyone holding the address may change it), yours, or another (only its owner, signed in, may change it).

deletedAt.description: When the record was soft-deleted. Null while it is live.

driver.description: The one followed driver it is for, by slug (lewis-hamilton), or null for none.

kind.description: One of All: practice, sprint-qualifying, sprint, qualifying.

league.description: The league's code, such as F1.

meeting.description: The one meeting it is for, by slug, or null for every meeting of the league.

on.description: Whether the calendar holds that kind there.

settings.description: Its settings and each team's own, which an edit of its teams keeps.

calendar.description: The calendar's own choices and its sports' and leagues'; an empty one chooses nothing, so every setting is its default.

alarmMinutes.description: Minutes before the start an alarm goes off: AlarmOff, 30, 60 or 90.

games.description: All of a team's games, its home games, or its away games. Head-to-head games only.

alarmMinutes.description: Minutes before the start an alarm goes off: AlarmOff, 30, 60 or 90.

games.description: All of a team's games, its home games, or its away games. Head-to-head games only.

names.description: Short club names in titles, or both clubs' full names. Head-to-head games only.

scoreRevealHours.description: Hours after the start before a result shows: ScoreImmediately, 24, 48, 96 or ScoreNever.

version.description: The shape of the stored JSON.

leagues.description: Its choices for every team of one league, by league code (NFL).

names.description: Short club names in titles, or both clubs' full names. Head-to-head games only.

scoreRevealHours.description: Hours after the start before a result shows: ScoreImmediately, 24, 48, 96 or ScoreNever.

alarmMinutes.description: Minutes before the start an alarm goes off: AlarmOff, 30, 60 or 90.

games.description: All of a team's games, its home games, or its away games. Head-to-head games only.

names.description: Short club names in titles, or both clubs' full names. Head-to-head games only.

scoreRevealHours.description: Hours after the start before a result shows: ScoreImmediately, 24, 48, 96 or ScoreNever.

version.description: The shape of the stored JSON.

sports.description: Its choices for every team of one sport, by sport code (SOCCER).

version.description: The shape of the stored JSON.

teams.description: Each team in the calendar that has choices of its own; a team not listed is "as the calendar".

settings.description: What it chooses for itself; anything left out is as the calendar.

alarmMinutes.description: Minutes before the start an alarm goes off: AlarmOff, 30, 60 or 90.

games.description: All of a team's games, its home games, or its away games. Head-to-head games only.

names.description: Short club names in titles, or both clubs' full names. Head-to-head games only.

scoreRevealHours.description: Hours after the start before a result shows: ScoreImmediately, 24, 48, 96 or ScoreNever.

version.description: The shape of the stored JSON.

aliases.description: The other addresses the team answers to within its league (ClubAddresses), which move a reader to Slug; empty for most.

hashtags.description: Its hashtags in English, each led by #: those that go with the first of its English accounts that has any (SocialHashtags); empty when none does. Always a list.

home.description: Where it plays at home: its home venue's city, state and country, and where on the map; null without a venue. The home page's search finds a club by it (a city, a state, a country, or anywhere near a city), as a calendar's events already name the venue's address.

city.description: The venue's city, as stored: Miami Gardens.

country.description: Its country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 as stored: US, GB.

latitude.description: Where it is, in degrees; null when the venue has no position.

longitude.description: Where it is, in degrees; null when the venue has no position.

state.description: Its state or province, as stored (FL); null where the country has none stored.

kind.description: club, solo (one athlete, by that athlete's name) or national.

logoIsFallback.description: Whether LogoUrl fell back to the league mark, which may indicate a missing team mark.

logoUrl.description: The team's logo URL; always present, since resolution falls back to the league mark.

name.description: The name as the reader's culture shows it: an operator's name for that culture or English, else the stored one.

slug.description: The team's address within its league, from the stored name, so a renamed team keeps its links.

standing.description: Its place in the league's table, where the provider publishes one; null for every league without a table pull.

computedAt.description: When the provider last computed the table (UTC).

form.description: The last five results, oldest first, as W, D and L; null early in a season.

group.description: The table the team plays in, for a competition of several: Group A; null for a league of one table.

netRunRate.description: Cricket: the net run rate the table breaks ties on, as the provider computed it (0.744); null in every other sport.

noResult.description: Cricket: the games washed out with no result, which a cricket table counts beside wins and losses.

points.description: Points as the provider counts them, so a deduction is included.

rank.description: The table position, by the league's own tie-breaks.

zone.description: The zone the position falls in, in the provider's words: Relegation - Championship; null mid-table.

title: Calendar
